author: David Bombal
description:
20 petaflops of FP4 AI compute, under your desk. Chris introduces the GB300 DGX Station, combining Grace, a B300 GPU and 800Gb/s networking in a liquid-cooled workstation. He says it can run models with up to a trillion parameters, locally.

Would you run your AI on your own hardware?

Thank you to NVIDIA for sponsoring this video and my trip to GTC Berlin 2026.

#nvidia #ai #aicomputer
title: 20 petaflops under your desk
